findings.title: The F2 freeze does not cover all of L1 or the geometry modules the registration checks run on
findings.detail: config.freeze.files_meaning says the freeze covers 'L1 (physics/peec), which the registration checks use', but only physics/peec/model.py is hashed. model.py imports physics/peec/kernels.py (the partial-inductance kernels), and kernels.py is not in config.freeze.files. The same is true of geometry/conductors.py (the RectCell and ConductorModel types that Layout.to_conductors builds, which on_lattice uses), geometry/units.py and geometry/__init__.py. perturb.rules_sha256() and rules_supplement_sha256() do not cover these files either. If kernels.py changed after the freeze, every r_L1 would move, and with it the F4 l1_span gate and the coverage report, without freeze_hashes_match noticing.
findings.evidence: Importing perturb, peec.model, drc and l2_layout loads moduleforge.physics.peec.kernels, geometry.conductors, geometry.units and the package __init__ files. None of them appears in E004.yaml config.freeze.files. 'from .kernels import (' is at model.py line 90.
findings.suggested_check: Add physics/peec/kernels.py, geometry/conductors.py, geometry/units.py and the package __init__.py files to config.freeze.files, or hash every moduleforge module present in sys.modules after the registration imports.

findings.title: The frozen allocation almost never passes F4's span check, and the l2_layout 0.5 mm distribution O004 asks for is not reported
findings.detail: I recomputed the development span simulation from research/o004_e004/span_sim_case4.json with my own code. At lower end 0.75 no draw meets the span: 0 of 400 single-reference draws and 0 of 200 pooled draws. The per-draw counts of pairs below 0.90 are {0: 315, 1: 78, 2: 7}. This matches the research note. As drafted, a sealed registered run would be refused by F4 almost surely, and a refused sealed run stays on the record. The draft says so and leaves the decision to the founder, so the registration stage is implemented, but the design is not registrable. Separately, O004 scope_in requires that the development-seed ratio distribution be reported 'at L1 and at l2_layout 0.5 mm' before registration. Only L1 is reported.
findings.evidence: My recomputation gives pass counts single/pooled of 0/0 at 0.75, 0.78 and 0.80, and 0/1 at 0.85. Kind shares of r < 0.90 are die_row_shift 0.11, compound 0.06 and 0 for the other kinds, all matching the note.
findings.suggested_check: The founder decides the allocation or span before registration. Add the l2_layout 0.5 mm distribution on the Case 4 development pairs.

findings.title: The F4 gates and the 6 % coverage threshold are decided at a mesh where r_L1 is resolved only to about ±0.005
findings.detail: L1 runs at DEFAULT_HMAX = 4 mm. I recomputed the 12 smoke pairs at hmax 4, 2 and 1 mm and saw ratio shifts up to about 0.005. One terminal_copper pair went from 0.9953 to 1.0000, so its effect changed sign. One compound went from 1.0014 to 0.9965. Pairs within about 0.005 of 0.75, 0.90, 0.98 or |1 - r| = 0.06 could therefore flip the span gate or a coverage verdict. L1 is not the tool under test and the gate is deterministic, so this is admissible, but neither the spec nor the runner records hmax or the size of this effect.
findings.suggested_check: Record hmax in config, and report r_L1 at hmax/2 beside each gate value with the pairs within 0.005 of a threshold flagged.

findings.title: The reference lattice check is gated after the sealed draws, not before them as the docstring says
findings.detail: The runner computes ref_lattice in step 3 but only gates it inside layouts_on_lattice in step 6, after perturb.draw has consumed the sealed stream and L1 has been evaluated. A judged reference that is whole-mm but off a lattice (for example a substrate outline that is not whole mm) would therefore spend a sealed run before being refused. The module docstring says step 3 happens 'BEFORE any draw'. On the frozen 2R and Case 6 references both checks pass today, so this is latent.
findings.evidence: In stage_registration, step 3 calls gate('references_whole_mm') only. ref_lattice first reaches a gate in registration_checks, which runs after the draw loop.
findings.suggested_check: Gate ref_lattice together with references_whole_mm in step 3.

findings.title: Some sanity checks cannot fail
findings.detail: seed_provenance compares seed with the value main() just set it from: DEV_SEED in smoke mode, int(MFOS_SEED) in registered mode, and main() already raises if MFOS_SEED is missing. layouts_drc_clean_distinct is described as 're-checked independently of the draw', but it re-runs the same drc.check with the same rules and the same geometry_key that draw used. It repeats the draw's check rather than checking it independently.
findings.evidence: main(): seed = DEV_SEED or seed = int(os.environ['MFOS_SEED']); stage_registration: gate('seed_provenance', seed == DEV_SEED if smoke else seed == int(sealed_env)).
findings.suggested_check: Record each slot's derived draw seed, and re-derive the moves from MFOS_SEED in the check, comparing parameters.

findings.title: Latent KeyError once the proxy pair is built in smoke mode
findings.detail: In smoke mode the slot ids are '2D_Case_2R<-dev:2D_Case_4', but registration_checks appends the proxy record to per[cfg['proxy']['reference']], which is '2D_Case_2R'. That raises KeyError as soon as proxy_pair_status returns 'built' in a smoke run.
findings.evidence: registration_checks: per = {r: ... for r in ref_ids}; per[cfg['proxy']['reference']].append(...).
findings.suggested_check: Key the proxy record by its slot id.

findings.title: freeze_hashes_match fails in this snapshot only because the pinned commit is not in its history
findings.detail: In my smoke run the single freeze failure was 'pinned commit aea69183… is not an ancestor of HEAD'. The review snapshot is one commit with no history. Every file hash, perturb_rules_sha256, the supplement hash, l2_layout_source_sha256 and the numpy and shapely versions matched the frozen values, but I could not check the ancestry claim itself.
findings.evidence: registration.json freeze.failures has exactly one entry, the ancestry check; git log shows only '7accf29 review snapshot'.

findings.title: scipy is not pinned, although the solver under test uses it
findings.detail: config.freeze.packages pins numpy and shapely only. l2_layout, the code under test, uses scipy.sparse, scipy.sparse.linalg and scipy.fft. ExperimentRun records the scipy version in its provenance but nothing enforces it. This is a solve-stage (T0389) concern, but the freeze block is part of this deliverable.
